title: Not worth it
text: Over the last 5 years I have tried various cold pressed juice cleanses, so this is not my first.  This one was delivered with no cleanse guide included, so there is no way to know the order to take these.  There was no guidance offered about preparing for a cleanse or a pre-cleanse guide. Every other cold pressed cleanse I have purchased has had the order clearly marked.  I had to "ask the seller" three times before they emailed me their cleanse guide which was minimally adequate.  Again by comparison this cleanse falls short of a good cold pressed cleanse.  Amazon sells many different ones that are better than this. This was a subscription that I cancelled immediately. I will not waste my money on substandard products.
label: neutral
